svg.title: BlendLib geometry and typography specification
svg.desc: Separate construction sheet. The logo artwork is the same outlined geometry as the master; guides are not part of that artwork.
svg.text: Folded B as the initial letter. The remaining seven glyphs come from Minecraft.otf.
Visible gaps are measured between ink bounds, not advance boxes.
Two equal triangular counters; shared facet intersections.
None / equal x and y scale
All type paths are extracted from the supplied CFF font.
MASTER: 10 filled paths / transparent background / no live text, grid, dimensions or annotations.
